assessment_sequence: Identify the organization and its business activities.
Identify the countries and regions involved.
Identify the people whose data is processed.
Inventory the data collected, inferred, accessed, or shared.
Identify the roles of the organization and vendors.
Map data flows and storage locations.
Verify requirements against current authoritative sources.
Route uncertain or consequential interpretations for review.

decision_dimensions.question: Which jurisdictions may regulate the activity?
Does the organization meet the relevant legal definition or threshold?
Does the activity involve personal, health, sensitive, or regulated data?
What collection, use, disclosure, storage, and transfer activities occur?
Which vendors receive or access the data?
What permitted purpose and legal basis or authorization apply?

rules: Do not mark a framework not applicable merely because the website is public.
Do not equate collecting no form data with collecting no personal data; analytics and logs may still matter.
Do not mark a framework applicable solely because the customer uses healthcare terminology.
Record the reasoning and evidence behind each conclusion.
Reassess when jurisdictions, features, vendors, or data flows change.
